question: Who was the author of Buddhacharita?
solution:
The correct answer is **Ashvaghosha.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Early in the **second century **CE, **Ashvaghosha **of Sketa produced the **Buddhacharita**,
 
• An **epic poem** in the **Sanskrit maha kavya** form about the life of **Gautama Buddha**.
 
• **Ashvaghosha** was regarded as India's **greatest poet** and the founder of the Sanskrit play.
 
• He was also a **philosopher** and **poet**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vasumitra
 
 
• A classic **Buddhist text** is the **Mahavibhasa**.
 
• **Vasumitra**, a renowned **philosopher** of the **Kushan era,** is considered to have written it in **150 CE**.
 
• The Buddhist philosophy **encyclopedia** is also known by the name **Mahavibhasa**.
 
 
 
• Nagarjuna
 
 
• **Nagarjuna** is referred to as the "**Einstein of India"** because he developed the concept of **Shunyavada,** which is similar to **Einstein's theory** of relativity.
 
• One of the most significant **Buddhist philosophers** was Ngrjuna (c. 150–250 CE), who is also known as an **Indian metallurgist** and **alchemist** in some traditions.
 
• The** Madhyamika** school, a significant lineage of Mahayana **Buddhist philosophy**, is often credited with having been founded by **Nagarjuna**.​
